name: Nordstart
author: espen
description: Workspace launcher with pinned apps, an installed-app search, an app store, and session actions

schema.label: Open on hover
schema.description: Open the launcher when the pointer rests on the bar icon. Click and the keyboard shortcut still toggle it.

schema.label: Workspace preview
schema.description: Show a live preview of the selected workspace's window on the right. Turn this off if capture is slow or unsupported.

schema.label: Workspaces shown
schema.description: How many workspaces appear in the grid, empty or not. Hyprland workspaces above this are ignored.

schema.label: Launch apps on
schema.description: Where an app opens when you start it from the launcher. 'Current workspace' keeps you where you are, so a second terminal lands beside the first. Press n (or Shift-click) to start another copy of an app that is already running — that always opens on the current workspace.

schema.label: Pinned apps
schema.description: Comma-separated desktop entry ids. Running apps switch to their workspace; the rest open on the first empty workspace. Pin or unpin from the all-apps list to change this.

schema.label: App names
schema.description: Override display names. Use id=Name pairs (org.gnome.Nautilus=Files,firefox=Web) or a JSON object. User names win over the built-in map.

schema.label: App aliases
schema.description: Extra desktop-id aliases for pinning and running-state matching. Use id=alias|alias pairs (files=nautilus|org.gnome.Nautilus) or a JSON object.

schema.label: App store
schema.description: Show the app store view (key: s). Browses Omarchy's curated install catalog and searches Arch packages. Installs and removals run in a floating terminal.

schema.label: Search the AUR
schema.description: Include AUR results in app store searches, via yay. Off by default: AUR searches need the network and AUR packages are unvetted.

schema.label: Check plugins for updates
schema.description: Show installed Omarchy plugins in the app store and check their git remotes for updates every 6 hours. Off disables the check and all its network traffic. Press r in the store to check now.
